messages.plaintextBody:
Duncan,

Draft completion funds flow attached for your review against the net debt and working-capital position. Sources/uses balance at £34.0m (incl. £29.3m cash, £1.5m escrow, £3.2m debt repayment split £2.35m bank / £0.85m DLA). Please confirm the net debt figure before we finalise.

Best,

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
